description: Deterministic read-snapshot matrix used by sample/scripts/snapshot-matrix.sh. Commit versions are assigned in the order the demo script runs; this file documents the expected visibility rules rather than hard-coded numbers.

rules.case: snapshot before first commit of a row

rules.expect: newest row_version with commit_ver <= N, excluding deleted

rules.case: old snapshot after its version is recycled
same snapshot read twice across recycling
rules.expect: first content, then E_VERSION_RETIRED; never two different contents
